definitions.explanation: An island that is geographically separated from the mainland and typically difficult to access. In Japan, refers to the many smaller islands outside the four main islands.

examples.japanese: {離島|りとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I live on a remote island.

examples.japanese: {離島|りとう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アクセス→アクセス：10696_akusesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦フェリー→フェリー：11168_ferii⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The only way to access the remote island is by ferry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数百|すうひゃく}→数百：23368_suuhyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離島|りとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧や⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has hundreds of remote islands, each with its own unique culture and nature.

notes:
USAGE:
{離島|りとう} is used in official, travel, and geographical contexts. Japan has over 400 inhabited remote islands ({有人|ゆうじん}{離島|りとう}), many of which face challenges like depopulation and limited infrastructure. The government has specific policies for {離島|りとう}⟦{振興|しんこう}→振興：00471_shinkou⟧ (remote island development).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離島|りとう}⟦{振興|しんこう}→振興：00471_shinkou⟧ (remote island development/promotion)
- {離島|りとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live on a remote island)
- {離島|りとう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ (transportation to remote islands)
- {有人|ゆうじん}{離島|りとう} (inhabited remote island)
- ⟦{無人|むじん}→無人：13388_mujin⟧{離島|りとう} (uninhabited remote island)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {離島|りとう}: remote/outlying island (official, geographical term)
- ⟦{孤島|ことう}→孤島：12240_kotou⟧: isolated island (literary; emphasizes complete isolation)
- ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧: island (general term)
